position: EXP-1 killed the Keychain blocker: with per-instance CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, injected CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN wins and you do not touch the developer's login. Stop designing CredentialBroker cathedrals. v1 is three dumb Claude instances (or one instance whose env is re-resolved only when you rebuild the adapter) fed by an optional external select call — multi-instance is already the account primitive. Muse/Kimi stay T3-side static route/env profiles; aigate has no models API. Codex/Cursor/Grok/OpenCode: no. Mid-thread hop is kill-query+resume with new env (EXP-3), not magic, and env is captured at adapter construction (EXP-4) so anyone promising per-turn select without rebuild is lying.

claims.claim: Under isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is honored and Keychain does not rescue a bogus token; T3 already sets per-instance CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so aigate-style Keychain deletion is unnecessary.
claims.evidence: Chair EXP-1 (2026-08-17): CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<fresh> + BOGUS token → 401 (Keychain did not rescue); live setup_token → OK. Drivers/ClaudeHome.ts:27-33 sets per-instance CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Caveat n=1 box/binary; SDK path same binary via pathToClaudeCodeExecutable.

claims.claim: mergeProviderInstanceEnvironment spreads into a new object and does not mutate process.env; two instances with different tokens do not clobber each other.
claims.evidence: Chair EXP-4: ProviderInstanceEnvironment.ts:11 spread; called ClaudeDriver.ts:128.

claims.claim: queryOptions.env is captured once at adapter construction (makeClaudeEnvironment ~ClaudeAdapter.ts:1663, reused :4176), not re-read per turn/spawn. Dynamic per-turn account select requires new code or adapter/instance rebuild.
One long-lived SDK query() per thread; mid-thread account hop = kill query, new query with resume cursor + new env (turn boundary only), same shape as claude --continue.
claims.evidence: Chair EXP-3: createQuery at ClaudeAdapter.ts:4221, sessions Map:4280, resume via readClaudeResumeState/resume/resumeSessionAt.

claims.claim: SDK already emits rate_limit_event → account.rate-limits.updated; T3 can drive park/hop and optionally POST aigate /api/events/usage without scraping CLI stderr.
Pseudo-model slugs (muse/kimi) pass resolveClaudeApiModelId untouched; catalog gates UI picker not execution. Muse/Kimi are env+base-URL route profiles, not aigate concepts.
claims.evidence: EXP-6 ClaudeProvider.ts:464-471 pass-through; aigate-muse.sh env pattern; aigate has no /api/models (operator/chair).

claims.claim: aigate /api/select has no lease; concurrent hosts can get the same account; healing is TTL park + 10-min poll.
Codex/ChatGPT account rotation is out of scope for v1 — no live aigate backend.
claims.evidence: aigate-gpt.sh retired 2026-08-04, 402 out of credits; no Codex account pool in aigate.

claims.claim: v1 should stay zero-or-near-zero core abstraction: optional select-on-instance-start (or external sidecar writing sensitive instance env), reuse multi-instance, no first-class broker type upstream.
claims.evidence: Native ProviderInstanceId multi-instance; EXP-1 removes Keychain fight; EXP-4 means select-at-construction matches existing seams without a broker interface; CONTRIBUTING.md not accepting big features.
claims.test: Ship optional aigate URL/token in userdata secrets + one select at Claude instance/adapter build injecting CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN+AIGATE_ACCOUNT; disable path byte-identical to today; no Keychain writes; probe init.account matches selected account.

claims.claim: Automatic mid-session hop is phase 2: on rate_limit_event/exhausted, park via POST /api/events/limit, re-select exclude=, rebuild adapter env, resume query — not session-start-only forever, but not Monday.
claims.evidence: EXP-3+5 give the mechanism; warden already parks and --continues; T3 lacks rebuild-on-limit glue today.
claims.test: Two disposable accounts: exhaust A mid-thread, assert park+reselect+resume on B preserves thread context without duplicate tool side effects.

claims.claim: Upstream will not land an aigate-named or large broker feature; keep aigate adapter fork/external.
claims.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md not actively accepting contributions; brief big features closed.
claims.test: If ever upstreaming: PR only generic optional env-resolve hook, zero aigate strings; closed-as-policy ⇒ fork stays.

challenges.their_claim: Keychain vs env under SDK+CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is CONTESTED/unmeasured.
challenges.problem: Chair EXP-1 settled it: isolated config dir → env token wins; no Keychain clear needed. Holding CONTESTED past the experiment is stale.
challenges.test: Re-run EXP-1 bogus-token probe on SDK query() once if you distrust CLI parity; expect 401 not Keychain rescue.

challenges.their_claim: mergeProviderInstanceEnvironment may overlay onto process.env and race concurrent instances.
challenges.problem: EXP-4 falsifies the global-mutation reading: it spreads into a new object. Fitness issue was real as a question; answer is no race on process.env.
challenges.test: Read ProviderInstanceEnvironment.ts:11; concurrent unit test already implied by spread semantics.

challenges.their_claim: E0/E1 must block all integration code; Monday is read 14 lines + E1 only.
challenges.problem: E1 is done (EXP-1). E0 is done (EXP-4). Blocking on already-run experiments is procrastination cosplay. Monday is select-at-build + inject.
challenges.test: If SDK-specific reprobe desired: probeClaudeCapabilities init.account under isolated dir — half hour not a phase gate.

challenges.their_claim: useAigate on instance calls /api/select on instantiation and that is enough; model listing out of scope; park/reselect maps to switching instances between turns.
challenges.problem: Select-on-instantiation matches EXP-4 (good). Claiming per-turn headroom probe without adapter rebuild ignores env capture. Switching provider instances mid-thread is not the same as resume on same thread with new env — needs EXP-3 resume path proven in T3 UI/orchestration.
challenges.test: After limit event, continue same ThreadId via resume+new instance env; assert continuity vs forcing user to pick another instance manually.

challenges.their_claim: Phase 2 CredentialBroker interface in apps/server/src/provider/ dynamically invoking select on session init and retry.
challenges.problem: Named broker type in core is the cathedral. Optional function/config that returns env overlay at adapter build is enough; interface theater fails upstream and AGENTS.md generic-optional without new ontology.
challenges.test: Implement with zero new public types beyond config fields; if disabled, no new symbols required at call sites.

challenges.their_claim: Design first-class brokering + model listing via aigate as central questions.
challenges.problem: aigate is a vault/selector not a model directory (VERIFIED). T3 multi-instance + env seam + resume already shape the answer. The polite furniture is 'we need a broker concept'; the impolite question is 'what line of code is missing after EXP-1/3/4/5?' — adapter rebuild on limit + optional select call.
challenges.test: Monday spike: wire select→sensitive env on one Claude instance; prove init.account; document Muse as second instance with static env; stop.

retractions.was: Keychain/stored login outranking CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN under Agent SDK + per-instance CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is UNMEASURED and blocks every integration sketch.
retractions.now: VERIFIED safe under isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (EXP-1): env wins; do not delete Keychain; no fight with ai CLI on same Mac.
retractions.because: Chair EXP-1 bogus-token and live-token probes, 2026-08-17; ClaudeHome per-instance isolation.

retractions.was: Use only an external sidecar refreshing env with zero T3 code and treat any in-process select as cathedral.
retractions.now: A tiny optional select-at-adapter-build inside T3 (or sidecar + instance rebuild trigger) is justified; still reject a generic CredentialBroker ontology and upstream theater. Env is static at construction (EXP-4) so pure external file refresh without rebuild does nothing to a live adapter.
retractions.because: EXP-4 (env once at makeClaudeEnvironment) and EXP-3 (resume hop needs intentional re-create) force one honest hook point; chair research.

retractions.was: Defer all hop discussion as unmeasured process vs session confusion.
retractions.now: Hop mechanism is known: kill query + resume + new env at turn boundary; rate_limit_event already in adapter. Still phase-2 glue, not Monday.

needs_research: SDK query() identity probe (init.account.email/tokenSource) under isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with conflicting Keychain — CLI EXP-1 parity not literally SDK n=1
Whether T3 orchestration can swap ModelSelection/instance env and resume the same ThreadId without UI/session breakage (file-level path through ProviderService + clients)
Exact client files for provider status reverse states (web/desktop/mobile) for parked/reauth/broker-unavailable
Duplicate /api/select assignment rate under fleet N hosts and whether 15m TTL park is enough for T3 turn rates
dissent: I will not agree to a first-class CredentialBroker type, aigate /api/models, Keychain clearing, or Codex-in-v1. Consensus-ready once the plan is: optional select→inject at adapter build; multi-instance + static Muse/Kimi route envs; hop = phase2 resume+rebuild on rate_limit_event; fork/external aigate bits; Monday = wire select+secret env+probe identity on one instance. Test that flips me on broker ontology: show multi-instance cannot express headroom-ranked pick + park without a new type.
